pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark patches on the flank and lower neck exhibit irregular, sub-polygonal geometries. Edge angularity varies between sharp transitions and smoother pixel gradients. Patches on the mid-flank represent the largest relative spatial area, becoming smaller and more fragmented toward the ventral and anterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-toned network is continuous, forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate (Y-junctions) and occasionally quadri-radiate. Pixel thickness is variable, with noticeable narrowing between larger flank patches and wider spacing in the shoulder region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour. The silhouette is composed of fine, jagged pixel-level variations against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular, raised nodule is visible on the lower neck/chest region. It is characterized by a distinct reddish-brown texture and a disruption of the surrounding patch geometry, indicative of a localized skin lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small birds (oxpeckers) are present on the dorsal ridge and the lower posterior flank, creating localized points of textural occlusion.
